item.title: github: Copilot code review: New organization billing options and controls
item.description:
GitHub added billing and license controls for Copilot code review at the organization level. Organization owners can now bill code review usage to the org for members with Copilot licenses and manage related controls.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: License data quality improvements
item.description:
GitHub now sources license information for dependency graph software components from package registries such as npmjs.org and PyPI. This is intended to improve the accuracy and completeness of displayed license data.

  • Source: GitHub
